title: DYNEX CAPITAL INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Dynex Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its Board of Directors approved a new share repurchase program authorizing up to $300 million for common stock repurchases and up to $50 million for preferred stock repurchases. The program is authorized through April 30, 2028, and replaces the prior program expiring April 30, 2026.
key_points: Dynex Capital Board approved new share repurchase program on April 21, 2026
Authorization: up to $300 million for common stock and up to $50 million for preferred stock
Repurchases may be made via open market, privately negotiated transactions, or Rule 10b5-1 trading plans
Program replaces prior repurchase program expiring April 30, 2026
Board may modify, suspend, or terminate the program at any time; no obligation to purchase shares
